proposal.reason: Step 7's click succeeded (the failure was in the assert phase), and the snapshot at failure shows the app now interposes a confirmation: "This order exceeds $2,500 — click Approve again to confirm." with the Approve button still present and the confirmation heading rendered but hidden. The flow gained an interstitial second-click confirmation for orders over $2,500, so one extra click on the same #approve-button is needed before the existing step 7 click, which then commits the approval and reveals data-testid="confirmation". The inserted click asserts the interstitial warning the user sees; step 7 keeps its id, target and assert unchanged.
